scenes.say: It installs Ubuntu, Node and the harness inside the app, with no root and no Termux.

idea: DSH Go is an Android client that runs DeepSeek Harness on the phone or drives the one on a computer.

claims.text: DSH Go is an Android client for DeepSeek Harness that runs the harness on the phone or drives the one on a computer.
It installs Ubuntu, Node.js and DSH from inside the app, without root and without a separate Termux install.
You can send a message while it is replying, answer tool approvals, and finished steps fold into one line.
After permissions, the local engine reads the screen, taps and types, and sensitive actions stay with you by default.
